messages:
Priya: Hi team — my new MacBook Air (M2) finished DEP enrollment but macOS keeps showing a banner: "Profile installation pending user approval" and the MDM status in the portal says 'Awaiting user approval'. I don't see any system prompt. Anyone seen this?
Jordan (IT): @Priya welcome! Usually you should see a macOS dialog to allow the MDM profile. Can you check System Settings > Privacy & Security > Profiles and see if there's a profile pending? Also run `profiles status -type enrollment` and paste output if possible.
Priya: In Settings > Profiles I see nothing. Ran `profiles status -type enrollment` and it returned: 'No profiles installed'. But MDM portal shows device serial G0ZP12345LM.
MDM-Bot: Device G0ZP12345LM: DEP record matched, status: user-approval-pending, last-contact: 2026-04-05T08:22:10Z. Assigned profile: "standard-employee-v2".
Lee: Sometimes macOS suppresses the prompt if the user clicks 'Not Now' during OOBE. Try rebooting into normal session (not setup assistant) and check for a small banner near the top of System Settings.
Priya: Rebooted, still no banner. No profiles.
Jordan (IT): Ok let's try a targeted MDM push. I can resend an enrollment push that forces the macOS prompt. Two options: 1) We resend the enrollment profile so you get the accept dialog (recommended), or 2) I can temporarily assign you local admin to run a diagnostic script. Which do you prefer?
Priya: Resend the enrollment please. I don't want admin if unnecessary.
Jordan (IT): Roger. Pushing re-enroll now — you should see a system prompt asking to allow the configuration profile and to open System Settings to complete.
MDM-Bot: Re-enroll push issued for G0ZP12345LM (action: resend-enroll, initiated_by: Jordan (IT)).
Priya: I got the prompt! Clicked Accept, it asked to authenticate with my company SSO, completed.
Jordan (IT): Nice. After acceptance, run `profiles status -type enrollment` again and verify it shows an MDM profile. Also check FileVault status: System Settings > Privacy & Security > FileVault — we require it ON for corporate devices.
Priya: Running the command now. Output: 'MDM enrolled (profile: standard-employee-v2), last-checkin: 2026-04-05T08:30:45Z'. FileVault shows "Turned On" and recovery key escrowed.
OnCall: Quick note — if you need to install Rosetta or run Intel-only installers, let us know. We can either grant a short admin window or sideload a policy to install common dependencies.
Priya: I need Rosetta for one toolchain. Prefer a quick admin window for 30 minutes.
Lee: We can push a 30m temp-admin profile. After we've removed it, please verify you can no longer run `sudo`.
Jordan (IT): Pushing temp-admin-30m now. Accept the profile when prompted, then run `sudo /usr/sbin/softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license` or the Rosetta installer dialog will appear.
MDM-Bot: Profile install pending for G0ZP12345LM: temp-admin-30m.
Priya: Accepted. Ran the softwareupdate command and Rosetta installed. Also installed Homebrew.
Jordan (IT): Removing temp-admin profile now.
MDM-Bot: Profile removed for G0ZP12345LM: temp-admin-30m (actioned by Jordan (IT)).
Priya: Confirmed I no longer have admin. Everything else is working — VS Code, Docker for Mac (Apple Silicon build), and SSH keys loaded. Thanks!
Lee: Welcome aboard Priya! If you want my dotfiles or a devcontainer for the M2, ping me.
Jordan (IT): Logged ticket IT-4972 for the re-enroll and temp-admin action. Closing loop — reopen if anything strange pops up.
Priya: Appreciate the fast help :shipit:
